macros.name: colophonclrpg
macros.doc: If you want the colophon to clear one page, but not a double page, use \colophonclrpg, or the package option clrpg.

macros.name: colophonnofirstindent
macros.doc: \colophonnofirstindent, turns off colophon’s default behavior of suppressing the first indent after the title line.

macros.name: colophonparstyle
macros.doc: \colophonparstyle, which will govern the style of the text.

macros.name: colophonpostparhook
macros.doc: \colophonpreparhook and its brother, \colophonpostparhook, allows arbitrary commands to be run before and after the colophon text.

macros.name: colophonposttitlehook
macros.doc: The hooks are \colophonpretitlehook and \colophonposttitlehook. By default, both are empty; redefine them to whatever you need them to be.

macros.name: colophonpreparhook
macros.doc: \colophonpreparhook and its brother, \colophonpostparhook, allows arbitrary commands to be run before and after the colophon text.

macros.name: colophonpretitlehook
macros.doc: The hooks are \colophonpretitlehook and \colophonposttitlehook. By default, both are empty; redefine them to whatever you need them to be.

macros.name: colophontitlealign
macros.doc: You can align the title centered, on the left, or on the right, by using \colophontitlealign, or the titlealign package option.
